newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BHP says cyclone causes no mine damage.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BHP says cyclone causes no mine damage.

text.p: The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd said on Thursday that iron ore mining and shipping operations were returning to normal around the coastal community of Port Hedland, which weathered the brunt of cyclone Rachel.
The cyclone roared across the Western Australia town on Tuesday, halting mining from the Newman, Yandi and Yarri mines for about 36 hours and delaying loading and shipping, it said.

"It's all getting back to normal with no damage reported," a BHP spokesman told Reuters. The eye of the cyclone passed directly over Port Hedland on Tuesday packing winds in excess of 100 km per hour. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
